verdicts.explanation: Section 4.1 states the b-axis bulk conductivity of LiFePO4 at 30 °C is 1.2(1)·10−10 S cm−1, with the Arrhenius activation energy 0.70(3) eV for b, and the crystals were grown by optical floating zone.

The Section 5 Fig. 8 values of 1.2(7)·10−10 S cm−1 (||b) for LiFePO4 are the authors' own Arrhenius-fit values at 30 °C from this paper's data, not literature; the b-axis activation energy of 0.70 eV matches Table 2.
The Fig. 8 value 1.6(6)·10−11 S cm−1 (||c) for LiFePO4 at 30 °C is reported in this paper, and the c-axis activation energy of 0.68(2) eV matches Section 4.1 and Table 2.
The text reports 3.9(32)·10−11 S cm−1 (||b) for LiMn0.5Fe0.5PO4 at 30 °C from the Arrhenius fits, and Table 2 gives EA = 0.72(3) eV for b in that material.
The text reports 1.1(7)·10−12 S cm−1 (||c) for LiMn0.5Fe0.5PO4 at 30 °C, and Table 2 gives EA = 0.67(3) eV for c in that material.
The text reports 2.2(12)·10−14 S cm−1 (||b) for LiMnPO4 at 30 °C, and Table 2 gives EA = 0.86(3) eV for b in LiMnPO4.
The text reports 2.4(30)·10−14 S cm−1 (||c) for LiMnPO4 at 30 °C, and Table 2 gives EA = 0.85(4) eV for c in LiMnPO4.
